endpoints: Kokoro token durations, first non-stress token of the first command word
policy: New development challenge frozen after the Nick gates were trained. Whole-sentence synthesis for each name and carrier with matched voice, speed and separator. Name variants may affect coarticulation and timing. Fixed v5 takes the identical command PCM of literal Hey Nyx. Two seconds silence before each TTS output, one second after. Used training-pool voices; no independent holdout. Align candidate and official WakeNet to the same per-file clocks.
